video.name: SP Atom 4D
video.description: SP Atom 4D - the tesseract through a window in w (Thickness 0 = cross-section, 1 = projection): mitered bars (Edges, Round), Vertices, Faces opacity, layer styles on every wall (Thickness 0 = cross-section, 1 = projection with edges + translucent clipped Faces); Turn/Spin/Double; Sun/Height/Distance light the faces, edges and cuts; Shade; Edges (wireframe thickness) / Vertices (corner spheres) / Faces; layer styles on every face (Bevel/Emboss/Inner Shadow/Inner Glow/Gradient/Contour); Color Base gray/normal + Loop per channel. Contained. No drives.

video.name: SP Atom 4D Field
video.description: SP Atom 4D Field - window in w over a 4D distance-field catalog: any figure morphs to any figure, smoothly. The projected slab rendered as a STACK of N cross-sections through w (Layers/Spread/Sweep), front + back, Faces = opacity. Turn/Spin/Double/Sweep are POSITIONS (the heart drives), X/Y, Perspective, Sun/Height/Distance, Faces/Edges/Round/Vertices, Shade/Rim/Haze/Halo/Focus, Material (smooth/stone/crystal/glass) Micro/Fine, Color stack + Depth hue. Contained. No drives.

video.name: SP Atom Figure 2D
video.description: SP Atom FIGURE 2D - Figure A / B / Morph over a 2D SDF catalog (disc, ring, capsule, polygon, star, cross); containment; Turn, Spin (perspective coin flip), Outline (black stroke), Soft; layer styles: Sun, Bevel, Emboss, Inner Shadow, Inner Glow, Outer Glow, Satin, Gradient, Contour + Flow, Shadow (black alpha); Color = Base gray/normal + Loop per channel (Wet/Loop/Hue/R/G/B). No drives.

video.name: SP Atom Glyph
video.description: SP Atom Glyph - a glyph synth, one voice: Style (letter/rune/ogham/sigil), Language (the alphabet), Glyph (which of 24; between two, the strokes write out and in, in order), Ends (round/flat/serif), Write (0 blank to 1 whole, in stroke order), Size, X/Y (contained), Weight, Contrast, Slant, Width, Round (joins), Hand (the hand's drift), Soft. Grounded: ~3 strokes, roles on a baseline lattice, cardinal strokes, one oblique at most. White, alpha = coverage. No drives.

video.name: SP Atom Grain
video.description: SP Atom GRAIN - film / static / dust / lines; Amount, Size (cell px), Flicker (re-roll rate), Level. Alpha = value. No drives.

video.name: SP Atom Ground
video.description: SP Atom Ground v4 - a real camera over a lit, tiled plane: WORLD: Tilt (roll, full turn), Sway/Bob/Travel; CAMERA: Horizon (pitch), Yaw (turn), Dolly (dolly zoom), Focal mm (35mm-equiv), Lens (rectilinear/stereographic/equidistant/equisolid/orthographic), Distort (Brown-Conrady k1), Scale, Gap, Seam (gap tone; solid floor), Bands, Sun/Height/Relief, Haze, Soft. No drives.

video.name: SP Atom Hybrid
video.description: SP Atom 4D - the tesseract through a window in w; CONNECT blends the frame's distance field (walls + edges) with the stack's field: one level set morphs from walls to layers (Layers/Spread/Sweep/Drift) (Thickness 0 = cross-section, 1 = projection with edges + translucent clipped Faces); Turn/Spin/Double; Sun/Height/Distance light the faces, edges and cuts; Shade; Edges (wireframe thickness) / Vertices (corner spheres) / Faces; layer styles on every face (Bevel/Emboss/Inner Shadow/Inner Glow/Gradient/Contour); Color Base gray/normal + Loop per channel. Contained. No drives.

video.name: SP Atom Room
video.description: SP Atom Room - a real camera inside a fixed, lit, tiled box (Left/Right/Floor/Ceiling/Back/Front = where each plane sits, world units); WORLD: Tilt (roll, full turn), Sway/Bob/Travel; CAMERA: Horizon (pitch), Yaw (turn), Dolly (dolly zoom), Focal mm, Lens, Distort; Scale, Gap, Seam (gap tone; solid floor), Bands, Sun/Height/Relief, Haze, Soft. No drives.

video.name: SP Atom Script
video.description: SP Atom Script - real glyphs drawn exactly from the stroke corpus (latin, greek, futhark, ogham): Script, Glyph (walks; between two the strokes write out/in in the system's order), Write, Size, X/Y (contained), Weight, Ends, Slant, Soft. Alpha = coverage. No drives.

video.name: SP Atom Solid
video.description: SP Atom FIGURE 3D - Figure A / B / Morph; containment law; LIGHT sun/height/distance/shadow; MATERIAL smooth/stone/crystal/glass + micro/fine; COLOR gray/loop/normal; LINE shade/edge/emboss. No drives.

video.name: SP Atom Texture
video.description: SP Atom TEXTURE - scanlines / halftone / hatch / weave; Count, Drift, Duty, Soft, Level. Alpha = value. No drives.

video.name: SP Atom Void
video.description: SP Atom Void - a medium with no surface: dust as points in an infinite 3D lattice, walked by the ray, seen through the field camera (Tilt, Sway/Bob/Travel, Horizon, Yaw, Dolly, Focal mm, Lens, Distort). Density, Size, Reach, Haze, Soft. No drives.
